summary: Who you are and your sense of responsibility work together. You carry a natural authority that doesn't need to perform, and self-respect that grows steadier with age. Maturity suits you.
body: Who you are and your sense of responsibility work together. You carry a natural authority that doesn't need to perform, and self-respect that grows steadier with age. Maturity suits you. People trust you with weight because you handle it. The catch is that ease can turn into coasting, leaning on the steady reputation instead of building the next real thing. Authority you don't keep earning goes stale. Keep stretching and you become the rare adult who actually grew up well.
gift: At your best: grounded, credible, an authority that wears well.
shadow: The trap: resting on the steady reputation instead of earning the next thing.
integration: Let identity and discipline and limits cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Disciplined and reliable; the risk is self-limiting caution and joyless striving.
do: Keep earning the authority, not just holding it
Take on weight you can grow into
